title: Replying to @Lillian Thomas if you havent already i highly recommend ...
transcript: You know what your problem is, Louis? Your problem is that you are so full of piping hot crap. That the mention of your name draws flies. Just so the record straight, I love prior, but I was never in love with him. I have a man uptown, and I have since long before I first laid eyes on your sorry little ass. I didn't know. No, because you never bothered to ask. Up in the air, just like that angel there. Too far off the earth to pick out the details. Louis and his big ideas. America. Big ideas is all you love, Louis. America is what you love. So what? Maybe I do. You don't know what I love. You don't. I hate America, Louis. I hate this country. It's nothing but a bunch of big ideas and stories and people dying. And then people like you. White cracker who wrote the national anthem knew what he was doing. He set the word free to a note so high nobody could reach it. That was deliberate. Nothing on earth sounds less like freedom to me. You come with me to room 1013 over at the hospital, Louis. I'll show you America. Terminal, crazy and mean. I live in America, Louis. That's hard enough. I don't have to love it. You do that. Everybody's gotta love something. Everybody does.
